title: Accessibility Violations
description: A newsletter sign-up form full of deliberate accessibility problems, with a switch to a fixed version, for practising automated and manual accessibility checks.

expected.title: Expected problems
expected.explanation: What a scan of the Newsletter sign-up section should find in the version shown, and how each problem is reported.
expected.none: None: the fixed version has no known problems.

rules.label: The Email address field has no label
rules.duplicate-id-aria: The First name and Last name labels share an ID, so both fields are named First name
rules.image-alt: The profile picture has no alt text
rules.heading-order: Your details jumps from a level 2 to a level 4 heading
rules.aria-required-attr: The weekly digest checkbox has no aria-checked
rules.aria-valid-attr-value: More options sets aria-expanded to yes or no instead of true or false
rules.scrollable-region-focusable: The terms box scrolls but cannot be focused, so it cannot be scrolled with the keyboard
rules.color-contrast: The privacy note is light grey on white
rules.button-name: The help button is an icon with no name
rules.link-name: The GitHub link is an icon with no name

keyboard-trap.name: Keyboard trap
keyboard-trap.problem: Tab and Shift+Tab never leave the Message box

mouse-only.name: Mouse only
mouse-only.problem: The Subscribe button cannot be reached with Tab

form.title: Newsletter sign-up
form.intro: Sign up for our weekly newsletter.
form.more-options-text: You can also choose to receive a monthly summary instead.
form.terms-clause: Clause {{number}}: we will only use your email address to send you this newsletter, and you can unsubscribe at any time from the link at the bottom of every email.
form.privacy: We will never share your email address with anyone.
form.help-text: Fill in your details and press Subscribe. You can unsubscribe at any time.
